\caption{Cross sections for inclusive production of negatively charged hadrons ($h^-$) in deep-inelastic scattering, for the kinematic region $150.0 < Q^2 < 300.0$~GeV$^2$ and $0.0021 \leq x < 0.0071$, tabulated in bins of the hadron energy fraction $z$ and the hadron transverse momentum $p_{T,h}$. The selection requires $Q^2 > 150$~GeV$^2$; only hadrons within the central tracking region, $|\eta_h| < 1.6$, are included. Each entry is the cross section in nb integrated over the corresponding four-dimensional bin; the bin volume is given in the last column of the table. The bin-averaged density (the cross section divided by the bin volume) is a derived quantity that is deliberately not tabulated, and model predictions must be integrated over the same bin volume before comparison with the tabulated values. The values are Born-level cross sections: they are corrected for detector effects and for radiative (QED and electroweak) effects; the correction convention is photon exchange only, i.e. the cross sections are defined without $Z$-boson exchange. Each cross section is quoted with its statistical uncertainty and its total systematic uncertainty. Two correction factors are tabulated for reference: the factor applied in this table (seventh column), which follows the photon-exchange-only convention, and the corresponding factor of the convention with $Z$-boson exchange included (sixth column); the ratio of the two factors converts a cross section between the two conventions. The values are preliminary and subject to change.}
